title: Tom and His Sister
text:
Tom is thirty years old. He works in a shop with his friend. He has sixty books at home. Every day he reads for twenty minutes.

On Sunday, Tom goes to the park with his sister. She is seventeen years old. They play football for one hour. Then they share ice cream and go home.

questions.text: How long do Tom and his sister play football?
What kind of person is Tom most likely?
options: A person who has no free time
A person who works in a park

questions.text: Who is older, Tom or his sister?

a girl or woman who has the same parents as you
looks at words and understands them
to give part of something to another person

paragraph_translations: Тому тридцять років. Він працює в магазині з другом. Удома в нього шістдесят книжок. Щодня він читає двадцять хвилин.
У неділю Том ходить до парку зі своєю сестрою. Їй сімнадцять років. Вони грають у футбол одну годину. Потім вони діляться морозивом і йдуть додому.
